### 明细表（可见行：No. 11–17）
表头字段：
- No. / Subject ID / Subject Status / **EOT-Discontinue Date** / **Discontinue Reason** / **if Agreed to come back in 52 week?** / **52 Weeks visit date** / EOS（该列在可见行中为空）

3. **No.13**｜Subject ID **2315600804**｜Study Discontinued｜**31-Jan-24**｜Acute ILD Exacerbation｜**N**（“The patient's condition worsened acutely… unable to cooperate in continuing any follow-up monitoring.”）｜**30-Aug-24**
4. **No.14**｜Subject ID **2315606302**｜Study Discontinued｜**31-Jan-24**｜Lung transplant｜**N**（“The patient refused to come to the hospital for fear of increasing the risk of lung infection.”）｜**15-Aug-24**
5. **No.15**｜Subject ID **2315601310**｜Study Discontinued｜**20-Mar-24**｜Malignancy（后续为中文描述，页面可见但较小）｜**Y**｜**24-Sep-24**
6. **No.16**｜Subject ID **2315600201**｜Study Discontinued｜**28-Mar-24**｜Acute ILD Exacerbation｜**N**（“His physical condition is very poor… take oxygen and cannot go out… home and site are not in the same city.”）｜**2-Jul-24**
7. **No.17**｜Subject ID **2315606305**｜Study Discontinued｜**28-Mar-24**｜Subject decision（“The patient's dyspnea worsened… was not relieved after being hospitalized… taking pirfenidone on his own from 20Mar2024.”）｜**Y**｜**22-Oct-24**
